information: This competition is dependant on the planned governmental increase on gatherings to 100 people on the 8th of July. Maximum of **ONE** guest per competitor. Maksimalt **EN** gæst pr. deltager. Vi tager ikke ansvar for potential sygdom du må påtage dig i anledningen af at deltage i konkurrencen.
